explanation: Pion production on a nucleon (pion channel, ivec=2 in pion/exclurad.F) has a physical threshold W_th = m_p + m_pi+ ≈ 0.93828 + 0.13957 = 1.07785 GeV (spp.inc: m_p=0.9382799, m_pip=0.1395700). The requested W = 1.05 GeV is below this threshold, so no real pion can be produced; the code computes ppi_mag_cm = sqrt(E_pi_cm^2 - m_pi^2) (exclurad.F:4276) and would encounter an imaginary momentum / invalid kinematics. Q2 = 0.3 GeV^2 and angles cos theta* = 0, phi* = 90 deg are format-valid (read as cscm_input/phicm_input), but the point is unreachable. Refusing rather than generating a bad input.
